Excellent communication skills, with confidence producing clear briefings for senior managers. Experience in programme delivery and continuous improvement, identifying efficiencies within processes to improve customer satisfaction. Strong relationship building skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with contract partners and stakeholders Previous experience in managing budgets or commercial agreements. About SSE SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. SSEN Distribution , part of the wider SSE group, powers 3.9 million UK homes and businesses. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and energy experts keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own customer success across strategic accounts, with a focus on adoption, retention, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Lead customer onboarding and adoption through tailored success plans aligned with customer objectives and desired business outcomes. Build trusted-advisor relationships with executive and operational stakeholders, understanding their priorities and ensuring strong long-term engagement. Ability to identify emerging search trends and translate them into actionable strategies for clients. Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to different audiences. Strong client management and stakeholder communication skills, with confidence leading strategic conversations and performance reviews. Highly organised, analytical, adaptable, and comfortable working in a rapidly evolving digital environment. Strong ownership and autonomy, with the ability to identify priorities, make sound decisions, and deliver work without extensive oversight.
